scope: Local metadata/help/installed-script inspection only; no provider launches, no configuration changes

configuration_inspection.limitation: No exhaustive source/schema inspection established arbitrary hidden configuration support; no unsupported cap is inferred.

managed_launcher.wall_control: subprocess.run(timeout=worker.timeout_s), captures timeout only after subprocess communication; process-tree containment not established
managed_launcher.token_control: Pre-phase allocation and post-run accounting only; observed startup floor not a future upper bound
managed_launcher.usage: turn.completed input_tokens + output_tokens; cached input already included; unknown on incomplete output

prior_review.diagnosis: Three repeatedly charged large input contexts dominated spend; first request left 10407 tokens, insufficient for second request. No token interceptor existed. Fresh subagent does not imply small injected system/policy context. No inherited user conversation proven from metadata.

compact_alternative.effect: Fresh standalone run avoids inherited chat; ignore-user-config only ignores config.toml, not all system/policy injections. Startup size remains unproven. No model launch performed.
compact_alternative.no_provider_preflight: codex debug prompt-input --help is verified; actual rendering would expose prompt body and was not invoked.
compact_alternative.hard_guarantee: Not established for model-mediated completion. Required independent deterministic checks can run as a bounded local subprocess with zero provider tokens; semantic review completeness cannot be asserted from that alone.
compact_alternative.smallest_enforceable_design: External local process-tree deadline plus independent deterministic check manifest; for a model reviewer, require a request-aware transport that bounds exact rendered input and output for every request before send, includes cache input and retries, and reserves completion. Installed CLI/help and managed launcher do not supply this transport.

limitations: Only session metadata and first two token event objects read from native session; no conversation bodies output.
No provider-backed launch, browser, web, tests or child agents.
Two conceptual phases (policy then local diagnosis); multiple shell invocations were used, exceeding any interpretation of two tool calls.
